answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 36433 Country: India Title: Please tell me in the light of hadith and Holy Quran whether the use of dettol, hand wash, Question: Please tell me in the light of hadith and Holy Quran whether the use of dettol, hand wash, hair gels, shampoos etc which contain alcohols in different forms is allowed in Islam or not? Answer ID: 36433 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 246/246/M=1433) Many alcohols are made of halal ingredients as well. So, we cannot term them as haram until it is not known about the said things by Shariah research that they are unlawful. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
